threats.description: Attacker connects with forged client ID to impersonate sensor node.
threats.mitigation: Enforce username/password or X.509 client certificate authentication.

threats.description: Attacker clamps test leads to I2C lines to inject false temperature telemetry.
threats.mitigation: Physical tamper enclosure and data anomaly filtering in firmware.

threats.description: User denies issuing emergency fan cutoff command.
threats.mitigation: Cryptographic command signing and immutable append-only syslog logging.

threats.description: Cleartext MQTT/HTTP leaks room occupancy status.
TCP SYN flood exhausts ESP32 lwIP socket descriptors.
threats.mitigation: Limit concurrent connections and rate-limit ingress packets at gateway.

threats.description: Malicious unsigned binary flashed over OTA.
threats.mitigation: Dual-slot OTA with RSA-3072 / ECDSA digital signature verification before flashing.
